nom: DIME Dewy Recovery Mask with NAD+

avis.texte: THIS is a LIFESAVER in Utah! My skin was so dry after moving here this saved me from dryness when I added it as the top layer of my nighttime routine. I will buy this forever and ever please never change the formula!
This product seemed to work right away . Leaves skin soft , smooth and bright . I use it daily at bedtime its like getting a facial while you sleep . A small amount goes a long way !
I have been using this cream for about a month. It does seem to hydrate my skin much more.

I love the dewy recovery mask! I put it on before bed and leave it through the night. My skin is renewed in the morning, so soft and hydrated. Highly recommend for any time of year! We live where it's hot and can be humid more than not, I imagine if we lived in a drier climate I could use this mask nighlty.
I use a thin layer as nightly lotion and I wake up so glowy and moisterized!

Love love love! I have been using this once/twice a week as an overnight mask. In the morning I use a warm wash cloth to wipe off. I wake up with a healthy, somewhat shiny skin. Plus it feels amazing while applying. I have acne prone skin - I thought it would cause breakouts but it has not!
Have bought several products, luv them all. The Dewey day cream and the night time cream ate a part if my saiky routine.
I love how the Dewey mask leaves my skin after using it overnight. My face is so soft and my makeup goes on so easily the next day.
This product is a definite yes for my daily dime skin routine ! A small amount goes a long way -it-glides on smoothly and keeps the skin moist and soft . Very impressed from the first try .
This mask is super gentle yet moisturizing. Great for overnight use.
Love this night mask! I alternate between my tbt night cream.
Getting glass skin without dangerous chemicals is ideal. I absolutely love this. It is better than I had expected.
I wanted something that was heavier and kept me moisturizes longer. This is it!! Love it.
My first time trying and I love it. My skin is very dry and the Dewy Recovery Mask is very rich in texture and is a great moisturizer. I will definitely order again.
At first I was unimpressed but I started to notice a difference around 6 or 7 weeks after starting use

Almost everything Dime makes agrees with my skin, so when this came out I had to order it. This doesn't work as an overnight mask for me, it is too heavy for some reason, my skin doesn't like it on through the night. Not sure why because it feels divine, it's dense without feeling icky. So in my routine I use it as a 15 min mask. It's great and helps give me the moisture and glow I need.

I've been using the DIME Dewy Recovery Mask, and I love it. It's great for hydration. It feels rich but absorbs well, leaving my skin soft and dewy by morning. It's especially nice when my skin feels dry or irritated. A little goes a long way.
I received this mask as a sample and loved it so much that I ordered the full size. It's a great overnight mask that hydrates and nourishes dry skin back to life. Must try in my opinion!

I live in a cold weather climate and have dry skin. It feels impossible to get the right amount of moisture and hydration. This product helps so much. It's creamy but also lightweight, absorbing softly. I feel like this is the legitimate alternative to beef tallow. It doesn't clog my skin and hydrates beautifully.
Very impressed with the way it makes your skin feel and look get many compliments on my skin
The dewy recovery mask is amazing! I am so glad that I added it to my routine!

I have very sensitive and stubborn skin and it's taken me a long time to perfect or at least what I think perfect is lol . . my skincare routine. So I use the same products and rarely add in something new unless it really catches my eye. This mask caught my eye and I bought it on a whim. I have not slept in it yet because I'm just nervous, but I've done the 15 min mask a bunch of times now and I've never seen results as fast as I have with this. It makes your skin SO soft. I feel like it's been just wiping away impurities in a way. I don't know what it is but it's amazing so far. Thank you dime I'm always impressed and happy :sparkles::sparkling_heart:
I love the Dewy Recovery Mask!! I love how my face feels and looks after I use it. I use it about twice a week.

avis.titre: My go to Bed time Mask!
avis.texte: I live in a dry climate and I am 65 years plus. I apply this Dewy Recovery Mask every evening to my face and neck area. It is wonderful! I love Dime products.
I have never felt a moisturizer so heavenly! Not greasy, not too thick or thin. Perfectly smooth, soft, creamy, luxurious! I have seen noticeable improvement in my skin since using. A must have!
I absolutely love Dime's Dewy Recovery Mask! I use it every night, overnight, and it such a great part of my skin care routine. So creamy and feels so luxurious. Love this mask and love Dime!
I just got the Dewey recovery mask. I love it! It's awesome. I have super dry skin and feel my skin is never moisturized enough. This is amazing. I have used it both at night and in the morning.
This dewy mask hydrates my skin and leaves it feeling glowy, fresh, and am actually noticing a difference in my skin texture, color and acne!
This makes my skin feel refreshed and leaves me feeling like I look younger
the best nighttime moisturizer. love it so much and will continue to buy!
If you need a hydration boost for your skin you'll love this product! Such a nice refresh after winter and cold weather season!

This recovery mask is the perfect refresher and my skin thanks me after every use! It helps to calm blemishes on my skin and immediately adds brightness. I personally like to use it after washing my face in the evening and let it sit for a couple hours before rinsing off and finishing my skincare routine. It feels like butter but is non-greasy. Absolutely love it and will be purchasing more!

I've only been using this mask for 3 months but I love it! I use it every other night. It's a big container and a little goes a long way. I've also used it on my hands when I've had eczema flare ups and it really helps!

I was sent this as an early tester. I never get picked for anything so this was so exciting! Ive used it at least 3 times a week. Sometimes as a mask. Sometimes I leave it on overnight. It really hydrates will and plumps the skin. Gives it a nice pick me up!

I recently moved back to an extremely dry and windy area, and this has saved my skin! I love the versatility of it from being used as an overnight mask or a quick 15 min mask. My skin has been glowinggg and so dewy and far from what I expected it to be with the environment I'm in. Definitely a repurchase!!
This mask makes my skin feel good and my skin soaks it up. I have worn it actually a couple times as a daily moisturizer also because my skin can be so dry. I highly recommend!

Goes on smooth, cool and creamy but feels light and smells divine! Smooth, soft skin in the morning when left on overnight and just the same results when used as a quick face mask. Feels like a luxury hydrating mask. Love it!

Absolutely love the DIME Beauty Dewy Recovery Mask—definitely a 5-star product! It leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft, hydrated, and glowing without feeling heavy. Perfect for when my skin needs a boost, and I wake up looking refreshed and dewy. A little goes a long way—highly recommend!
I am obsessed with this mask. It really has helped my skin with its radiance & glow. I will forever use this product!
Love!! I use this a couple times a week at night and my face feels so hydrated when I wake up in the morning. My skin tends to be more oily so the extra hydration from his mask really helps.
This mask feels so luxurious when you put it on, and really feels like you are dousing your face in moisture. So far it hasn't broken out my acne prone skin using it a couple of times a week.
Love the mask. Makes my face feel refreshed and hydrated. I would recommend.
I love using this mask overnight on my forehead to combat winter dryness. I wake up with smooth skin, without it becoming oily.
I have been using this every night for 1 month and can definitely tell a difference in the moisture, texture and overall glow of my skin!
I generally really liked this mask made my face soft and hydrated. The only thing was i notice a few blemishes pop up a day later but mild.
Dime does it again. Another new product to love. Makes my face feel great and super hydrated.
I recently purchased this & I am happy to report I will continue to purchase this! It is a dream, my skin looks so dewy & soft every morning!
These products are top tier and clean for a reasonable price!
My skin retains so much moisture with this mask! I use it daily and will continue to reorder.

As someone who struggles w/ acne and uses a lot of acne based products, this is so so helpful! My skin is so sensitive to everything and is different everyday. When I started using this, it's been way more consistent!! Always wake up feeling so refreshed!
I love how smooth and soft this makes my skin feel. I'm so glad I tried it.
Best product invented!! Skin feels amazing before bed and when I wake up! I use this as a daily night time moisturizer due to my very dry skin and couldn't be happier with the results!
This is a miracle worker. My sensitive skin soaks it right up.

The Dewy Recovery Mask offers such a noticeable difference to my skin after a nighttime application! In the morning my skin felt silky smooth, not greasy at all! The mask just absorbs into my skin leaving it soft and smooth.
I tried this just out of curiousity and FELL IN LOVE! It feels so amazing on my skin. Like nothing else ive ever used! I recommend it all my clients! I wish i discovered Dime a long time ago.

I just started using this, so I cannot speak of long term benefits, but right away my skin felt softer and hydrated. It is also at a much better price point as to the night cream I was using. I will definitely purchase again.

This is a product that I never want to be without. I use it overnight and wake up with hydrated skin. It is not heavy and doesn't really have a scent to it, which I prefer. I really like that it does not transfer to my pillow case. Definitely a great product!
This saved my skin through the cold winter! I applied at night before bed and was so pleased with how moisturizing it was! And less fine lines!
Jar is big and a little goes a long way so I am happy that this will last awhile. So far it seems fine! Happy w the ingredients and hoping to see a difference in my skin over time.
Love this mask so much! I wear it overnight and it's so hydrating and my skin looks so dewy and hydrated in the morning! My new go to mask that I will be repurchasing!
This is a nice thick moisturizing mask. Doesn't have a weird sticky texture. Feels great after rinsing the next morning.
Love most the dime products, especially the day cream. Had to give this new product a try for before bed hydration, and it didn't disappoint! Girl my face be feeling so smoove! 10/10

I realize "life changing" sounds extreme, but it's true. I have had flaky dry skin that's embarrassing and this took care of it in one night and then continues to work. I used to have to scrub my face so hard and now I just use this. Helps my confidence so much and yes, that is life changing!
I use it at night. I leave it on overnight. My skin feels soft and hydrated in the morning.

I am not sure if it' age, environmental factors, cold weather, or hard water, but my face has been struggling. I wake up with big dry patches on my face, as well as peeling. Once I started using the Dewy Recovery Mask twice a week, I have noticed that my skin is soft and moisturized once again. I use it before bed and then rinse off in the morning. I absolutely love it and will buy again and again!

This is the most hydrating mask/cream I've ever had. An amazing product to get your dry face back on track.
My skin looks so moisturized and dewy in the morning after I wear this mask at night
I've enjoyed using this mask. I leave it on all night. Skin feels great. But nothing will fix 75 year old wrinkles. ;-) i would consider buying again.
So far I have been very pleased with this. I put it on every night with my blue tansy and my skin is still hydrated in the morning.

I absolutely love this mask! It' so easy to apply which is what I was going for. I've only done the applying of the mask at bedtime and rinse it the next morning. My face is so smooth and it' just something I wanted to pamper myself.

I really enjoy this mask, it is hydrating and feels great on, also my skin is noticeably more hydrated the next day even if just used at as a 15 min mask. Will be repurchasing.

I just received the Dewy Recovery Mask on Monday. I tried it last night (Tuesday). I used my favorite cleanser (sorry. . . not a DIME cleanser) and the DIME Toner. I applied the DIME Hyaloronic Acid Serum as I do every night and skipped the other Serums and Moisturizers. I applied the Mask and left it on all night and rinsed my face with warm water. My skin looks FANTASTIC!!! I will see how it goes but I might replace the Restorative Night Cream for this three times a week. My skin is plump and my 11 o'clock lines and my beginnings of forehead lines were non-existant! I did not rewash my face, I just rinsed with warm water and applied my DIME Toner and my morning DIME regimine of Serums and Dewy Day Cream. I did not even have to put as much Dewy Day Cream on. This is wonderful!!! Another A+++
